req.title: Task id is auto-generated
req.statement: The system shall assign a unique integer id to each new task; client-supplied ids in the payload shall be ignored.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-030 requires that (1) every POST /tasks/ response carries an auto-generated integer id, (2) two successive creates yield distinct ids, and (3) any id supplied by the client in the request body is silently ignored and overridden by the server. The test suite covers: EP-positive (normal create returns integer id), NEG (client-supplied id is ignored), BVA (two consecutive tasks get strictly different, positive integer ids), DT (payload with id field still yields 201 and server-assigned id), and STC (id monotonically increases across sequential creates). Each test uses exact-value or exact-type assertions to kill constant-mutation, comparison-flip, and boolean-negation mutants.

actions: POST /tasks/ with valid title, no id field
expected: HTTP 201 Created

trace: R-TASK-030: system shall assign a unique integer id
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine, Base

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_auto_generated_id_is_integer_and_positive():
    payload = {"title": "Auto ID Task", "description": "desc", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert "id" in body
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
    assert body["id"] > 0
    assert body["title"] == "Auto ID Task"
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert "created_at" in body
    assert "updated_at" in body

test_auto_generated_id_is_integer_and_positive()

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine, Base

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_two_consecutive_tasks_get_distinct_ids():
    r1 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "First Task", "completed": False})
    r2 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Second Task", "completed": False})
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    assert r2.status_code == 201
    id1 = r1.json()["id"]
    id2 = r2.json()["id"]
    assert isinstance(id1, int)
    assert isinstance(id2, int)
    assert id1 > 0
    assert id2 > 0
    assert id1 != id2
    assert id2 == id1 + 1

tests.name: test_id_not_present_in_create_schema_and_response_id_retrievable
actions: POST /tasks/ with minimal valid payload (title only)
expected: POST returns HTTP 201 with a server-assigned id
GET with that id returns HTTP 200 and the same task
GET response id matches POST response id exactly
trace: R-TASK-030: unique integer id assigned; verifiable via GET
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine, Base

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_id_not_present_in_create_schema_and_response_id_retrievable():
    r_post = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Retrievable Task", "completed": False})
    assert r_post.status_code == 201
    post_body = r_post.json()
    assigned_id = post_body["id"]
    assert isinstance(assigned_id, int)
    assert assigned_id > 0
    r_get = client.get(f"/tasks/{assigned_id}")
    assert r_get.status_code == 200
    get_body = r_get.json()
    assert get_body["id"] == assigned_id
    assert get_body["title"] == "Retrievable Task"
    assert get_body["completed"] == False

test_id_not_present_in_create_schema_and_response_id_retrievable()

tests.name: test_multiple_tasks_all_have_unique_ids
actions: POST /tasks/ five times with different titles
expected: All five responses return HTTP 201
All five ids are positive integers
All five ids are pairwise distinct (set length == 5)
Ids form a strictly increasing sequence
trace: R-TASK-030: unique integer id to EACH new task — uniqueness across N creates
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine, Base

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_multiple_tasks_all_have_unique_ids():
    ids = []
    for i in range(5):
        r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": f"Task {i}", "completed": False})
        assert r.status_code == 201
        task_id = r.json()["id"]
        assert isinstance(task_id, int)
        assert task_id > 0
        ids.append(task_id)
    assert len(set(ids)) == 5
    for j in range(1, len(ids)):
        assert ids[j] > ids[j - 1]

test_multiple_tasks_all_have_unique_ids()
